A1-L3.objective: Bước 2 (Biến thể): Viết câu phủ định với isn't/aren't để nói rằng một việc chưa đúng hoặc chưa sẵn sàng.

items.prompt: Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: The slides ____ ready for the meeting yet.
Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: Our developers ____ free this week.
Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: I ____ sure the task is hard for the team.
Chọn câu đúng để nói rằng tuần này việc giúp đỡ chưa sẵn sàng: help is ____ ready this week.

A1-L8.objective: Bước 1 (Nhận biết): Tìm các đại từ I, me, my, mine, he, him, his trong một tin nhắn nội bộ về buổi họp tổng kết.

items.prompt: Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: Please send ____ your notes after the meeting.
Chọn câu có đại từ đứng trước động từ:
Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: The learning notes are ____ for the team meeting.
Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: Our manager asked ____ to lead the project review.

A2-L8.objective: Bước 1 - Nhận biết: Tìm các liên từ and, but, or, so, because trong email nội bộ và xác định hai ý được nối.

items.prompt: Chọn từ đúng để hoàn thành câu: We finished the task early, ____ the manager was pleased.
Chọn liên từ đúng: The result was good, ____ the deadline was very tight.
Chọn liên từ đúng: We can complete the report today ____ we can finish it next Monday.
Chọn liên từ đúng: The company missed the target, ____ the team prepared a new plan.
Chọn liên từ đúng: We delayed the task ____ the data from the client was missing.

B1-L8.objective: Step B1 (Identify): Notice past simple sequences and past continuous background in a real meeting summary.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the past simple for a finished action in order?
options: I was sending the file when the call started.
I sent the file, then I called the client.
I was calling the client while the file sends.
While I sent the file, I was calling the client.
items.answer: I sent the file, then I called the client.

items.prompt: Which sentence shows a short completed action interrupting a longer action?
options: While we were discussing the plan, the partner called.
When we were discussing the plan, the partner called.
We discussed the plan while the partner called.
While we discussed the plan, the partner was calling.
items.answer: While we were discussing the plan, the partner called.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the past continuous for background.
options: The team agreed on the date when the manager arrived.
The team discussed the budget, then the manager arrived.
The team agrees on the budget while the manager arrives.
The team was discussing the budget when the manager arrived.
items.answer: The team was discussing the budget when the manager arrived.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly shows the order of two finished actions?
options: We were agreeing to the plan, then we signed the contract.
We agree to the plan, while we were signing the contract.
We agreed to the plan, then we signed the contract.
We agreed to the plan while signed the contract.
items.answer: We agreed to the plan, then we signed the contract.

B1-L16.objective: K1 Contrast A–B: choose Present simple vs present continuous or Past simple vs past continuous and past habits for each situation about describing your current and previous jobs (contribute, workflow, assess).

items.prompt: Every Monday, our team ____ the workflow before the weekly meeting. (review / is reviewing)
This week, I ____ ideas for the year-end report while my manager is away. (contribute / am contributing)
When I worked in my old company, I ____ the sales results every Friday. (assess / assessed)
While I ____ the workflow in my old job, the system suddenly stopped. (check / was checking)

B2-L8.objective: Day 7 (Step 1 – Identify): Find the if-clause with had + V3 and the result clause with would have + V3 in a short project review message.

items.prompt: Read the message: "If we had tested the login feature earlier, we would have found the bug before the release." Which part is the if-clause?
options: we would have found the bug
If we had tested the login feature earlier
items.answer: If we had tested the login feature earlier

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the third conditional structure?
options: If the client had approved the plan in June, we would have started the pilot in July.
If the client approves the plan, we will start the pilot.
If the client approved the plan, we would start the pilot.
If the client has approved the plan, we start the pilot.
items.answer: If the client had approved the plan in June, we would have started the pilot in July.

items.prompt: In the review message "If Lan had joined the kick-off meeting, she would have understood the scope much better," which words form the result clause?
options: she would have understood the scope much better
items.answer: she would have understood the scope much better

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the founder in a third conditional message?
options: If the founder reviews the budget, the team will avoid the overspend.
If the founder had review the budget, the team would avoid the overspend.
The founder would have reviewed the budget if the team had avoid the overspend.
If the founder had reviewed the budget in June, the team would have avoided the overspend.
items.answer: If the founder had reviewed the budget in June, the team would have avoided the overspend.

C1-L8.objective: Day 1 (Step 1 – Identify): Notice be to in an official schedule notice and be about to in a short workplace update.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses be to for an official schedule?
options: The finance team is about to submit the year-end report.
The finance team has submitted the year-end report.
The finance team submit the year-end report on Friday.
The finance team is to submit the year-end report on Friday.
items.answer: The finance team is to submit the year-end report on Friday.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses be about to for an action happening very soon?
options: The board is to approve the budget next month.
The dashboard was about to yesterday.
The meeting is about to start, so please take your seats.
We are about to the delegate list.
items.answer: The meeting is about to start, so please take your seats.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the structure with a delegate.
options: The delegate is to attend the contingency briefing on Monday.
The delegate are to attend the contingency briefing.
The delegate to attend contingency briefing Monday.
The delegate is attend the contingency briefing on Monday.
items.answer: The delegate is to attend the contingency briefing on Monday.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses be on the point of with a dashboard update?
options: The IT lead is on the point of publish the dashboard.
The IT lead is on the point of publishing the dashboard.
The IT lead on the point of publish the dashboard.
The IT lead is on the point to publish the dashboard.
items.answer: The IT lead is on the point of publishing the dashboard.

items.prompt: Recall: which sentence uses the correct form of a past topic structure?
options: The sales manager has reviewed the tracker already.
The sales manager have reviewed the tracker already.
The sales manager reviewing the tracker already.
The sales manager reviewed the tracker already today yesterday.
items.answer: The sales manager has reviewed the tracker already.

items.prompt: Choose the best polite request: '____ if we could postpone the review to next week.'
The reports ____ all afternoon, so my eyes are tired and the desk is covered in paper.

A1-L4.prompt: Nghe và chọn từ bạn nghe được.
Nghe và chọn từ bạn nghe được.
